items.title: DSTA and Digantara partner to advance in space situational awareness
From metal to code: Indian defence startups embrace software for future growth
items.description: As venture capitalists pour funds into the defence-tech ecosystem, startups are aiming to transform into full-stack companies.

items.title: Digantara raises USD 50 million to advance sovereign space intelligence
India’s Digantara raises $50M for space-based missile defense tech
items.description: The all-equity Series B round included new investors such as 360 ONE Asset and SBI Investment of Japan, as well as serial entrepreneur Ronnie Screwvala, with existing backers Peak XV Partners and Kalaari Capital also participating. The funding comes more than two years after the startup’s $10 million Series A1 round, bringing its total capital raised to $64.5 million.

items.title: ispace, Digantara join forces on cislunar SSA
items.description: ispace and Digantara are partnering to keep track of objects in cislunar space. The pact between the Japanese lunar company and Indian space situational awareness (SSA) firm comes at a critical time. As traffic picks up around the Moon from government and commercial missions, knowing what else is in the neighborhood will be critical for safety and deconfliction.

items.title: Digantara and ispace launch collaboration to build asia’s lunar future
Telespazio joins forces with Digantara and Intella
items.description: Telespazio Germany announced plans to enhance its EASE-Rise mission management platform with Digantara's space situational awareness (SSA) services and Intella's artificial intelligence tools. Integrating Digantara’s product, which is not subject to U.S. and European export controls, with EASE-Rise “is opening up a whole range of possibilities,” said Andres Martinez, Telespazio Germany head of sales. “This is an end-to-end offering that we can provide to everyone.”

items.title: SEOPS to include early spacecraft detection and monitoring services with launch contracts
items.description: In an industry-first move, a partnership with Digantara delivers complementary accelerated post-launch spacecraft identification and persistent monitoring amid rising orbital traffic.

items.title: Digantara and Telespazio Germany forge strategic alliance to advance autonomous orbital safety on EASE-Rise
items.description: By integrating Digantara’s intelligent flight dynamics, EASE-Rise sets a new benchmark for space safety and autonomous operations.

items.title: SEOPS adds service to find sats after launch with Digantara
items.description: SEOPS Space is expanding its services to help customers quickly find and make contact with their satellites after launch.

items.title: World Economic Forum selects Digantara for its 2025 Technology Pioneers Community
items.description: Digantara has been named to the World Economic Forum's (WEF) 2025 Technology Pioneers list, for providing crucial operational support to commercial space operators and space surveillance intelligence to global space agencies.

items.title: Hurun India: Top 10 youngest entrepreneurs under 30 in India 2025
items.description: India’s startup ecosystem is witnessing a generational shift, as more young founders are breaking away from conventional career paths to build their own ventures.

items.title: Meet Asia’s 30 Under 30 entrepreneurs making robots and rockets
items.description: From humanoid robots to reusable rocket launch vehicles, young entrepreneurs are reshaping Asia’s industrial manufacturing scene and delivering cutting edge products.

items.title: Digantara commissions SCOT, sets a new standard for space surveillance
Digantara commissions world's first commercial space surveillance satellite
items.description: The world's first commercial space surveillance satellite, capable of tracking objects as small as 5 centimetres orbiting the Earth, was commissioned on Saturday as it captured images over South America, Digantara said. Digantara had launched the space surveillance satellite SCOT (Space Camera for Object Tracking) on January 14 aboard SpaceX's Transporter-12 rocket.

items.title: Forbes India 30 Under 30 2025: Digantara, building Google Maps for space
items.description: With the launch of Digantara Research’s SCOT satellite, Founder and CEO Anirudh Sharma and his co-founders have joined an elite club of space tech entrepreneurs who are building space surveillance and intelligence technologies.

items.title: Digantara eyes $30 million revenue with US expansion
items.description: Space tech firm Digantara said on Tuesday it is targeting $25 million to $30 million in revenue over the next two years by expanding into the U.S., aiming to secure large-scale defense contracts and tap into the $60 billion space surveillance and intelligence market.\n

items.title: Digantara expands to the U.S., investing in strategic space surveillance and intelligence capabilities
Digantara and ArianeGroup join forces to provide advanced SSA and electro-optical sensor data solutions for Indian and global markets
Digantara, ArianeGroup join hands for better space traffic management system
items.description: Digantara founder and CEO Anirudh Sharma signed the Memorandum of Understanding with ArianeGroup, marking a significant step towards enhancing space situational awareness (SSA) and electro-optical sensor data solutions for both Indian and global markets.

items.title: U.S. Space Force Rapid Capabilities Office selects companies for tech accelerator
items.description: Digantara teams up with Anduril Industries, a U.S. defense technology firm, is known for integrating artificial intelligence into defense systems. The program, run in partnership with defense contractor FedTech, is designed to identify emerging space technologies that could enhance the safety of satellites in orbit.

items.title: At Davos, Digantara CEO explains why its work is important for national security
items.description: The space surveillance and intelligence firm Digantara got the idea of tracking objects in space after seeing the huge problem of space debris, founder and CEO Anirudh Sharma told NDTV at Davos.

items.title: Prime Minister lauds Digantara at the success of Mission SCOT
items.description: He remarked that it was an important contribution of the growing Indian space industry towards enhancing space situational awareness.

items.title: Digantara launches India’s first homegrown space surveillance mission addressing space safety and security, aboard SpaceX’s Transporter-12 mission
Space Machines Company inks Digantara partnership
items.description: Australian – Indian in-space servicing firm Space Machines Company has signed strategic partnerships with India’s top aerospace and defence manufacturer, Ananth Technologies, and full-stack space infrastructure company Digantara. The deal marks a significant milestone in Space Machines Company’s mission to revolutionise space operations and traffic management.

items.title: Forbes Asia names Digantara in its 100 To Watch 2024 list
items.description: Fourth annual Forbes Asia 100 to Watch list showcases small companies and startups in Asia-Pacific that grabbed investors’ attention — and their checkbooks.

items.title: Deep Tech India: How Digantara is building a strategic space domain awareness platform
items.description: Anirudh Sharma, co-founder and CEO of Digantara Research and Technologies, gives us a quick update on progress at his space situational awareness venture in Bengaluru. The aim now is for Digantara to become a more holistic platform providing broader space domain awareness, for both commercial and strategic purposes. In this conversation, Sharma also talks about the challenges of building a deep tech company from India that can sell its products to global customers

items.title: Digantara chosen for Australia-backed debris management project
items.description: Digantara, in collaboration with various partners, is part of the Maitri mission to manage space debris. The company aims to enhance space traffic management and monitoring of Resident Space Objects in Low Earth Orbit.

items.title: ET Startup Awards 2023: Digantara wins Best on Campus category
items.description: Founded in 2018 by Lovely Professional University students Anirudh Sharma (CEO) and Rahul Rawat (COO), who teamed up with aerospace engineer Tanveer Ahmed (CTO), Digantara started with the goal of creating a sustainable space environment using patented technology.

items.title: Anirudh Sharma on space traffic management policies for managing space debris
items.description: Large constellations come with many benefits but also challenges. The challenges in terms of potential for collisions, orbital debris, and space traffic management (STM) are significant, threatening stability and safety in orbit as well as space sustainability.
